lines.port: // Beyond four actions the lower screen draws the menu in two columns (3ds_party_grid.h, the same arithmetic): the D-pad walks
// them the same way, UP / DOWN inside the cursor's column (wrapping in it), LEFT / RIGHT to the other column. TRUE when the
// D-pad was used (A and B go first, as in the list input): then the list input must not read it again.
int dir = keys == DPAD_UP ? CTR_PGRID_UP : keys == DPAD_DOWN ? CTR_PGRID_DOWN : keys == DPAD_LEFT ? CTR_PGRID_LEFT
int to = dir < 0 || JOY_NEW(A_BUTTON | B_BUTTON) ? -1 : CtrPartyGrid_Move(count, Menu_GetCursorPos(), dir);
